Case study · 2026

Harbor Goods Dark Ops Dashboard

A dark, data-dense store analytics dashboard with a live order feed, a real API and five working pages.

Live project · GitHub repository

Role
Product design, frontend and backend development
Platforms
Web, API
Year
2026

Problem

Operators need to read revenue, orders, traffic and stock at a glance, and a dark operations view has to stay legible, accessible and responsive under dense data.

Process

  1. Interface

    Built a pixel-matched dark dashboard with KPIs, a hand-drawn SVG revenue chart with hover markers, a live order feed, a traffic donut and stock alerts, checked against the reference at desktop and mobile widths.

  2. Backend

    Wrote a Node.js API with Hono, SQLite and Zod: session sign-in with rate limiting, server-sent events for live orders, and endpoints for orders, products, customers, analytics and settings.

  3. Quality and delivery

    Covered the work with unit, API and Playwright tests including accessibility checks, then shipped it as one Docker service on Render alongside a mock-data demo on GitHub Pages.

Result

A working dashboard with Overview, Orders, Products, Customers, Analytics and Settings pages, available as a no-login demo and as a full-stack deployment.

Stack

  • React
  • TypeScript
  • Vite
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Node.js
  • Hono
  • SQLite
  • Docker
  • Playwright
